narrative.overview: The home is one teal object seen through a phone. Surfaces are flat tinted fills in the logo's teal and ink, lifted from the ground by a one-pixel lit top edge instead of blur, gradient or drop shadow. Only what needs the person takes full colour: an amber question, the active destination, the connection arcs.
keyCharacteristics: Flat tonal layers, lit top edge, no blur, no gradients, no shadows.
Teal bar and ink bottom navigation frame a pale teal (or deep ink-teal) ground.
Full colour is rationed: amber for a waiting question, red only for failure.
State by shape (dot filled/ring, arcs lit/dim) plus words.
48dp minimum targets, sp type, edge-to-edge, system Back.

rules.name: The Full Colour Rule
rules.body: Only what needs the person takes full colour: the open question, the active destination, the lit arcs. Anything else is a tonal fill.

rules.name: The Failure Red Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for failure text. A waiting question is amber, never red.

rules.name: The Same Palette Rule
rules.body: The web page declares the same values as custom properties; change a colour in both places.

rules.name: The Scale Only Rule
rules.body: Sizes come from the Material text appearances in sp; do not set ad hoc pixel sizes in the shell.

rules.name: The Lit Edge Rule
rules.body: A raised surface is a flat fill plus a one-pixel top highlight. No blur, gradient or drop shadow.

dos: Do keep surfaces flat: tonal fill plus a one-pixel lit top edge.
Do show state by shape plus words (dot filled or ring, arcs lit or dim).
Do keep the bar teal with ink icons in both schemes.
Do keep targets at 48dp or more and type in sp.
Do use the same hex values in `colors.xml` and the web page's custom properties.
donts: Don't use blur, gradients or drop shadows for depth.
Don't use colour as the only signal of state.
Don't use red for anything but failure, or amber for anything but a waiting question.
Don't add navigation destinations for features that do not exist (no fake Watch or Profile).
Don't fall back to the grey-screen-plus-blue-accent default.
